test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

I have work in the morning, but I **__is freer__** in the afternoon.
solution:
The correct answer is **"am free."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• We always use subject pronouns which means that the form** "am"** is never used without the pronoun **"I"** so we always say **"I am."**

 
 
• **Example**:* **I am**__ free to attend your meeting.*
 
 
 
• The correct verb form for the first person singular present tense is **'am'.**
 
• The correct adjective form to describe** 'I' **in this sentence is 'free', which agrees with the subject 'I'.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *I have work in the morning, but I **__am free__** in the afternoon.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 -** 'is freed**' is incorrect because it uses the passive voice and changes the meaning of the sentence.
 
• Option 2 -** 'No improvement'** is incorrect because the original sentence contains an error.
 
• Option 3 - **'am frees'** is incorrect because it uses the wrong verb form and adjective form.
